campaign_limitations.finding: The V0 effect runner exits after the first failing iteration. A killed mutant therefore proves one complete 56-case discovery iteration plus exact replay, while a survivor must complete 56x32.
campaign_limitations.recommendation: Add a collect/continue mutation mode so all deterministic iterations can be measured after first discovery without 32 wrapper invocations.
campaign_limitations.replay_environment: The shared runner records the dependency-bearing virtualenv interpreter without a project-specific site-packages import-root workaround.
campaign_limitations.replay_environment_recommendation: Keep replay tests that execute the recorded command verbatim from a different working directory.
